question.problem:
Which of the following probabilities could be approximated using the normal approximation of the binomial distribution?

I. The probability that $5$ flights out of $50$ arrive late at an airport if the probability of arriving late is $0.09$ for each flight.

II. The probability that a student correctly solves $3$ questions in a $5$-question math test if the student has a $46%$ probability of correctly answering each question.

III. The probability that a biased coin lands on heads more than $30$ times out of $80$ coin flips if the probability of a single flip landing on heads is $0.52.$
